name: IFTTT
description: IFTTT lets agents run actions in the services and devices connected to the signed-in IFTTT account, such as a Slack message or smart lights, and create applets. Each user signs in to their own IFTTT account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my connected services can you use through IFTTT?
Suggest applets that save new email attachments to cloud storage.
Set up an applet that turns on my porch light at sunset.

apps.name: IFTTT
apps.description: Actions in connected services and applet creation, over IFTTT's MCP server with browser sign-in.
